measures.jurisdiction: San Juan County Fire Protection District No. 4 (Lopez Island Fire & EMS)
measures.title: Property Tax Levy for Fire Protection and Emergency Medical
measures.what_it_does: Restores the Lopez Island fire and EMS district's regular property tax levy to $0.74 per $1,000 for 2027 collection (Resolution No. 2026-02) and lets the levy grow up to 3% a year, instead of the usual 1%, for 2027 through 2035; the 2035 maximum becomes the base for later limits.
measures.cost_line: $0.74 per $1,000 of assessed value for 2027 collection, up from about $0.47, then up to 3% a year levy growth through 2035.

taxes.basis: YES approves a local tax, levy, bond, or annexation measure for the listed public service.

measures.title: Term Length of Port Commissioners
measures.what_it_does: Lengthens the term of Port of Lopez commissioners from four years to six (Resolution No. 2026-2). Current commissioners keep their terms; six-year terms apply to commissioners elected later.
measures.cost_line: No tax. The port says six-year terms would put one seat, not two, on the ballot every other cycle and lower its election costs.

taxes.basis: YES approves a local tax, levy, bond, or annexation measure for the listed public service.

measures.jurisdiction: Orcas Island Park and Recreation District
measures.title: Six-Year Property Tax Levy
measures.what_it_does: Renews the Orcas Island park and recreation district's regular property tax levy for six years at $0.15 per $1,000 (Resolution 2026-07-09), subject to the limits of chapter 84.55 RCW, to fund district programs, services and facilities such as Buck Park.
measures.cost_line: $0.15 per $1,000 of assessed value for 2027 collection (the 2025 rate was about $0.10), for six years; about $120 a year on an $800,000 home.

taxes.basis: YES approves a local tax, levy, bond, or annexation measure for the listed public service.

measures.title: Excess Property Tax Levy for 2027
measures.what_it_does: One-year excess property tax levy of $210,000 for the Lopez Island dump's operations and capital improvements in 2027 (Resolution No. 20-2026); the district may only levy one year at a time, so it asks every year. Needs 60% approval.
measures.cost_line: $210,000 for 2027 only, estimated at $0.091 per $1,000 of assessed value (about $45.50 on a $500,000 property), the same amount as the current levy.

taxes.basis: YES approves a local tax, levy, bond, or annexation measure for the listed public service.
